description: This script is a utility for cleaning up download directories in OpenWrt, deleting older versions of program tarballs while keeping the latest.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a file entry in the download directory, capable of parsing filename versions and deleting files.

methods.name: parseVer_1234
methods.description: Parses version from filenames with major.minor.patch.build format.

methods.name: parseVer_123
methods.description: Parses version from filenames with major.minor.patch and optional patchlevel.

methods.name: parseVer_12
methods.description: Parses version from filenames with major.minor and optional patchlevel.

methods.name: parseVer_ymd
methods.description: Parses version from date format in filenames.

methods.name: parseVer_GIT
methods.description: Parses version based on file modification time for GIT-sha filenames.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, lists files, filters blacklisted files, and deletes older versions.
